474cabb6ff.q: What is the Hilton Netherland Plaza in Cincinnati known for regarding paranormal activity?
474cabb6ff.a: The Hilton Netherland Plaza is the most haunted building in Cincinnati, Ohio. It has 30 floors and is home to a resident ghost called the Green Lady, whose husband was mysteriously killed during the building's construction with his body never found. She fell from the 12th or 13th floor and roams the halls looking for his body. Guests have reported feeling uncomfortable presences, such as sensing someone sitting on the end of their bed or feeling watched.
474cabb6ff.e: TEC Talk JUMP SCARE: Dave Okapi and the Mystery of the Haunted Hotel (Live from the 2026 ABMA/IAATE Joint Conference in Cincinnati, OH)

e847355c81.q: What was the silent auction fundraising result at the 2026 ABMA IAATE Joint Conference?
e847355c81.a: The Silent Auction at the 2026 ABMA IAATE Joint Conference made $15,000. 053ef3885a.q: Which Cincinnati Zoo bird show was established by Gary Densler and continues under Eddie's direction?
053ef3885a.a: The Cincinnati Zoo Bird Show was originally established by Gary Densler and is currently run by Eddie, who does the bird show at the Cincinnati Zoo. The show is a major attraction at the zoo and was showcased during the conference's Zoo Day event.

e12a78dbc9.q: What artistic murals are featured on the Cincinnati Zoo's City Barn enrichment lab?
e12a78dbc9.a: The City Barn, which serves as the Cincinnati Zoo's enrichment lab, is covered in 18 murals by artist Charlie Harper. These murals are extremely colorful and instantly recognizable. The building was formerly a horse and hoofstock barn for the zoo and features iconic Charlie Harper artwork on windows and doors, including a giant tiger picture on the main door.
e12a78dbc9.e: TEC Talk JUMP SCARE: Dave Okapi and the Mystery of the Haunted Hotel (Live from the 2026 ABMA/IAATE Joint Conference in Cincinnati, OH)

89c3f83a17.q: What happened when Chris took an Uber to Cincinnati Zoo before the free flight workshop?
89c3f83a17.a: Chris's Uber driver took him to the City Barn instead of directly to the Cincinnati Zoo. While there, Chris discovered the enrichment lab building, met staff, toured the facility including the 3D printer and scanner rooms, and viewed historical schematics of original zoo enclosures from 1873 before walking to the zoo. This happy accident allowed him to see the Charlie Harper murals on the building's exterior.
